fairness.title: Fairness verification
fairness.intro: Every check below runs on your device. We never tell you a hand was fair — you recompute it and see for yourself.
fairness.paste: Paste a finished hand’s published data here…
fairness.verifiedBlurb: All six checks passed. This hand was not tampered with.
fairness.failedBlurb: At least one check did not match. Open the failed step to see both values.
fairness.couldNotRead: Could not read that round data:
fairness.step1Blurb: The server locked its seed before the deal and could not swap it after
fairness.step2: Final seed is the agreed combination
fairness.step2Blurb: Server seed, all player seeds, a future block hash, and the round id
fairness.step3: Your seed is in the mix
fairness.step3Blurb: Every seated player contributed, in seat order
fairness.step4Blurb: Shuffling with the final seed gives the same cards that were dealt
fairness.step5: Nothing about the round was altered
fairness.step5Blurb: Seven fields hash together to the recorded round hash
fairness.step6: The round is in the on-chain record
fairness.step6Blurb: Its proof rebuilds the published Merkle root, so it cannot be deleted
fairness.provableBlurb: We own the rules, and every round is verifiable
fairness.vendorBlurb: An outside supplier owns the rules; each result is signed, but their paytable cannot be proven unchanged
fairness.ratesPending: Published payout rates are not shown yet. A rate is only meaningful once the rules behind it are committed on-chain and versioned — until then it would be a number we assert about ourselves, which is what this page exists to avoid.

reputation.title: Reputation
reputation.scope: Reputation affects which tables you can join and chat access. It never affects deposits or withdrawals.

jackpot.needsMore: ₮{{amount}} more before this tier can pay out
jackpot.howItWorks: Pools grow from 0.5% of each winner’s profit — losing players never contribute. A tier can only pay out once its pool passes the minimum shown, and Grand additionally requires players seated during the Saturday window.

welcome.title: Welcome to MYPOKER
welcome.body: Texas Hold’em, Omaha, Dou Di Zhu and more — with real players, around the clock.

fair.title: Every hand is verifiable
fair.body: The deck is decided by the server, every player at the table, and a blockchain block nobody can predict. You can recompute any hand yourself.

play.title: Sit down and play
play.body: Browse the lobby, pick a table at your stake, and take a seat. You can add funds whenever you’re ready.

vip.signInToSee: Sign in to see your VIP standing
vip.coefficientNote: Games count differently toward VIP: Texas ×1.0, Niu Niu ×0.5, Baccarat ×0.3, others ×0.4. This keeps low-rake games from being a shortcut up the tiers.
